hero.headline: Immigration can be complex. Your guide does not have to be.
hero.subheadline: Avilo guides individuals and families through every step of the immigration process — with expertise, clarity, and care.

services.title: How we can help
services.subtitle: End-to-end immigration support tailored to your situation.

card1.title: Visa & Permit Applications
card1.description: We handle the full application process for work permits, family reunification visas, and long-stay authorizations.

card2.title: Family Reunification
card2.description: Bringing families together across borders. We guide you through every document and administrative step.

card3.title: Integration & Settlement
card3.description: Language support, civic integration courses, and guidance to help you build a stable life in your new country.

card4.title: Asylum & Refugee Support
card4.description: Compassionate guidance through the asylum process — from application to recognition, we stand by you at every step.

card5.title: Document Legalisation
card5.description: Apostille, certified translations, and legalisation of official documents for use in European immigration procedures.

card6.title: Work Authorization
card6.description: Single permits, work visas, and employer sponsorship guidance for professionals relocating to Belgium and the Benelux.

card7.title: Student Visas
card7.description: Study permit applications and enrollment support for international students pursuing education in Europe.

card8.title: Appeals & Legal Support
card8.description: If your application was refused, we review your case, prepare a strong appeal, and represent your interests before authorities.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple, transparent process — from first contact to approval.

step1.title: Tell us your situation
step1.description: Fill in a short form or book a call. We assess your case and explain your options clearly.

step2.title: We prepare your file
step2.description: Our experts collect all required documents, complete forms, and submit your application on your behalf.

step3.title: You get your approval
step3.description: We follow up with authorities and keep you informed every step of the way until you receive your decision.
